en_title: South of Midnight Creative Director Would Have Turned Off Xbox 'Money Tap' Earlier, Says Funding Was 'Unsustainable'
cn_title: 《午夜之南》创意总监称自己本会更早关闭XBOX的「资金水龙头」，表示这种资金支持「无法持续」
opus_summary: 《午夜之南》创意总监David Sears表示，他一直担心微软的慷慨资助会结束，若由他掌管XBOX，可能会更早停止投入。他认为这种资金投入不可持续，并称赞微软让Compulsion Games等工作室独立，而非将其关闭。

paragraphs.en: David Sears, creative director of South of Midnight, said in a recent interview that he was always worried about the previous era of Xbox's infamous development funding "money tap," and admitted he would probably have turned it off earlier.
paragraphs.cn: 《午夜之南》创意总监David Sears在最近的一次采访中表示，他一直担心XBOX此前那个时期臭名昭著的开发资金「水龙头」，并承认自己可能会更早将其关闭。

paragraphs.en: The Xbox Game Studios-published South of Midnight launched in 2025, seven years after Compulsion Games' previous game came out. While it enjoyed critical acclaim, it failed commercially. Compulsion split from Xbox this year amid CEO Asha Sharma's "reset" of Microsoft's video game business, which has seen thousands of staff lose their jobs, multiple owned studios go independent, and multiple projects canceled.
paragraphs.cn: 由XBOX Game Studios发行的《午夜之南》于2025年推出，距离Compulsion Games上一款游戏问世已有七年。尽管该游戏广获好评，却在商业上遭遇失败。今年，Compulsion与XBOX分道扬镳，当时CEO Asha Sharma正在「重置」微软的视频游戏业务，这一过程中数千名员工失业，多家旗下工作室独立，多个项目被取消。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with MinnMax , Sears said he was always worried Microsoft's generous funding of South of Midnight would end. “I literally told people, I was like, 'Wow, this could be terrible,’” he said. “Because somebody is going to say one day, 'You know the money tap? We're closing those floodgates.' And that's going to have really traumatic results downstream.”
paragraphs.cn: 在接受MinnMax采访时，Sears表示，他一直担心微软对《午夜之南》的慷慨资金支持会结束。他说：「我真的跟别人说过，『哇，这可能会很糟糕。』因为总有一天会有人说，『你知道那个资金水龙头吗？我们要关上那些闸门了。』而这会在后续造成非常惨痛的后果。」

paragraphs.en: Next, he was asked if he’d have turned off the tap earlier himself if he was in charge of Xbox, to which he replied: “Yeah, probably.”
paragraphs.cn: 接着，他被问到如果自己掌管XBOX，是否会更早关闭这个水龙头，他回答说：「是的，很可能会。」

paragraphs.en: “I wanted to make [South of Midnight], no doubt. Obviously, because we made it,” he continued. “Would I have turned off someone else's money flow before South of Midnight? Yeah, because I'm not completely selfless. But in hindsight at least, it was unsustainable. So, of course it was going to have a shocking outcome."
paragraphs.cn: 他继续说道：「我想制作《午夜之南》，这毫无疑问。显然是这样，因为我们做出了这款游戏。我会不会在关闭《午夜之南》的资金之前，先切断其他人的资金来源？会，因为我并非完全无私。但至少事后看来，这种做法是无法持续的。所以，它当然会产生令人震惊的结果。」

paragraphs.en: Microsoft bought Compulsion in mid-2018 as part of a spate of acquisitions designed to bolster subscription service Game Pass' day-one offering under previous gaming boss Phil Spencer. That summer, Xbox's ranks were swollen by the arrival of Forza Horizon developer Playground, State of Decay developer Undead Labs, Hellblade developer Ninja Theory, the aforementioned Compulsion Games, then, later that year, inXile and Obsidian. Microsoft also formed a new studio in Santa Monica called The Initiative, which worked on the canceled Perfect Dark reboot. Microsoft acquired Double Fine the following year, in June 2019.
paragraphs.cn: 微软于2018年年中收购了Compulsion，这是前游戏业务负责人菲尔·斯宾塞任内一系列收购的一部分，旨在加强订阅服务Game Pass的首日游戏阵容。那个夏天，《极限竞速：地平线》开发商Playground、《腐烂国度》开发商Undead Labs、《地狱之刃》开发商Ninja Theory以及前述的Compulsion Games加入，壮大了XBOX的队伍；当年晚些时候，inXile和Obsidian也加入其中。微软还在Santa Monica成立了一家名为The Initiative的新工作室，该工作室曾开发已被取消的《完美黑暗》重启项目。微软于次年，即2019年6月，收购了Double Fine。

paragraphs.en: “It’s easy to dissect it now, but at the time I would talk to other directors who would be like, ‘How is this happening? How did we get so lucky? Is this a golden era?’ And I would always be like, ‘For now.’ There’s always a night when Rome burns. I didn’t know exactly when it would be but I was always worried about it.
paragraphs.cn: 「现在剖析这件事很容易，但当时我会和其他总监交谈，他们会说，『这怎么会发生？我们怎么会这么幸运？这是一个黄金时代吗？』而我总会说，『目前是。』罗马总有燃烧的那一夜。我不知道那究竟会在什么时候发生，但我一直为此感到担忧。

paragraphs.en: “But to their credit — amazing. I think there’s definitely a corporate Microsoft DNA, but they are vastly different from the Microsoft I knew back in the ‘90s and early 2000s — much more humane, actually. It’s remarkable and commendable.”
paragraphs.cn: 「但值得称赞的是——太了不起了。我认为他们身上肯定有微软的企业基因，但他们与我在90年代和2000年代初认识的微软截然不同——实际上人性化得多。这很了不起，值得称赞。」

paragraphs.en: Sears went on to praise Microsoft for letting studios spin off from Xbox rather than shut them down, pointing to how Microsoft bought Ensemble Studios only to shut it down after a couple of games. Like Psychonauts developer Double Fine and State of Decay maker Undead Labs, Compulsion Games secured its independence instead of being closed.
paragraphs.cn: Sears接着称赞微软让工作室从XBOX分拆出去，而不是将其关闭，并指出微软曾收购Ensemble Studios，却在它制作了几款游戏后将其关闭。与《意航员》开发商Double Fine和《腐烂国度》制作商Undead Labs一样，Compulsion Games获得了独立，而不是被关闭。

paragraphs.en: Deathloop and Dishonored 2 developer Arkane Lyon, however, is still looking for a buyer as Xbox explores options to split from the studio. Hellblade developer Ninja Theory went through the same process , but didn’t find a buyer and closed as a result.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，《Deathloop》和《耻辱2》开发商Arkane Lyon仍在寻找买家，XBOX则在探索与该工作室分道扬镳的方案。《地狱之刃》开发商Ninja Theory经历了同样的过程，但没有找到买家，因此关闭。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year, Microsoft announced that the next mainline Halo game will be developed by Call of Duty maker Activision , with mass layoffs hitting Halo Studios. Xbox has moved Age of Empires developer World's Edge and Sea of Thieves developer Rare under the Activision umbrella. Microsoft is doubling down on its biggest video game franchises as it works to improve revenue at Xbox and grow its profit margin.
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，微软宣布下一款《光环》正传游戏将由《使命召唤》制作商动视开发，同时光环Studios遭遇大规模裁员。XBOX已将《Age of Empires》开发商World's Edge和《Sea of Thieves》开发商Rare划归动视旗下。微软正加大对其最大视频游戏系列的投入，同时努力提高XBOX的收入和利润率。

paragraphs.en: South of Midnight was Compulsion's third game, following Contrast in 2013 and We Happy Few in 2018. It retains ownership of its games and publishing rights despite leaving Xbox.
paragraphs.cn: 《午夜之南》是Compulsion继2013年的《Contrast》和2018年的《We Happy Few》之后推出的第三款游戏。尽管离开了XBOX，该公司仍保有其游戏的所有权和发行权。
